title: Galloping Gertie
caption:
The bridge had a nickname for its wobble before it even opened. It was not a compliment. 🌉
Wind around a thin, shallow deck made it twist, and each twist fed the next: aerodynamic flutter tore it apart four months after opening.
Would you have driven across it?
sources: Washington State DOT, Tacoma Narrows Bridge history (opened 1 July 1940; collapsed 7 November 1940 in a steady ~64 km/h wind; aeroelastic flutter; wind-tunnel testing of later bridges)
